current_profile_snapshot.groove_behavior: laid-back pocket with syncopated or half-time drum programming; trap-derived subdivisions may appear without defining all tracks
current_profile_snapshot.phrase_behavior: melodic/vocal-like phrases with space, repetition-with-variation and pre-chorus/chorus contrast
current_profile_snapshot.harmony_behavior: extended tonal harmony, chromatic mediants, modal mixture and loop-based progressions as controlled options
current_profile_snapshot.bass_behavior: sub/electric bass sustained or syncopated, often sparse around lead
current_profile_snapshot.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: hybrid electronic/acoustic percussion, half-time snare/clap, detailed hats and low-end kick
current_profile_snapshot.instrument_role_behavior: voice/lead, EP/piano/synth target, sub/electric bass, drums, guitar/textures optional
current_profile_snapshot.ensemble_player_behavior: lead-centered production; accompaniment supports negative space and sectional layering
current_profile_snapshot.dynamic_behavior: intimate verses with larger chorus layers; automated swells common
current_profile_snapshot.articulation_behavior: soft attacks, vocal-like bends, muted guitar/keys, detailed programmed percussion
current_profile_snapshot.timing_humanization_behavior: laid-back pocket and quantized-plus-human hybrid timing
current_profile_snapshot.continuous_performance_control: continuous expression, filter automation, modulation and vocal-like pitch expression where appropriate
current_profile_snapshot.mix_prominence_intent: lead and low end foreground; pads/effects placed behind
current_profile_snapshot.production_mastering_intent: modern low-end controlled master with clear transient/vocal space
current_profile_snapshot.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires electronic voice/patch access in addition to canonical instruments
